# Pitch

## Hook: capture attention in the first seconds

We are all open books, trees of knowledge, living dictionaries. Yet all of this often stays
implicit, buried in our minds, and becomes hard to reach over time. Every day, we take in a
massive flow of information without managing to structure this knowledge durably: neither for
ourselves, nor to share it effectively with those around us.

## The problem

The central question is this: how can we capture, structure and preserve all this everyday
knowledge in our memory and, just as importantly, how can we make the open work that we are
readable? In other words, how can we reduce the distance between ourselves and our own knowledge
and, in doing so, how can we bring people closer to one another through this knowledge?

## The solution

We propose Eugenia!

Eugenia is an educational and social platform that lets you extract, structure and durably
remember the knowledge that comes from everyday life.

Throughout this journey, an agent based on various artificial intelligence algorithms – Eugenia
herself – accompanies users in the extraction, structuring and review of their own knowledge
tree.

In addition, Eugenia creates intellectual links with the people around us by revealing the
similarities and complementarities of our knowledge.

Eugenia sets up a virtuous circle: everyone builds their tree of knowledge, which they keep
enriching with the knowledge of others and of their own environment.

## The value proposition

Eugenia promises to increase our capacities for analysis, learning and memorization. Whether you
are a student, a researcher or passionate about all kinds of subjects, Eugenia offers better
capture and easier sharing of our knowledge.

## Differentiation

On the market, Eugenia compares with:

+ NotebookLM: extraction and structuring of knowledge from our everyday sources
+ Anki: memorization through spaced repetition
+ Wikipedia: tree structuring of knowledge
+ Social networks: sharing and broadening of knowledge

Eugenia unifies these principles in an environment that we want to be:

- decentralized, in the spirit of web 3.0: users remain sovereign over their data, since they
  are the only ones to own it
- open source, transparent and ethical: anyone can check the code and how the AIs work on their
  data

## Achievements

Two proofs of concept validated the technology: automated extraction and structuring, strategic
reinforcement of knowledge, and finally the visualization as a social graph.

An MVP is in progress, with first deployments planned: the CiuP library (academic), DiploCité
(non-profit), Woopets (industry).

## Conclusion

openEugenia offers a new way to learn, structure and share knowledge, with respect for ethics
and privacy. Join us to make digital sovereignty and collective intelligence a reality
accessible to all!
